The '''Trandoshan Relic''' was a tablet under [[Darth Skotia]]'s possession in his [[Darth Skotia's bunker|bunker]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] were obliged to serve whoever owned it. It was [[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|stolen]] from the bunker by [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] and was later used by the apprentice in his [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|duel]] with Darth Skotia, turning his Trandoshan bodyguards against him. However, Skotia easily killed the Trandoshans.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
